text.body:
— Sādhananidānaśrīcakrasaṃvara-nāma-pañjikā
(Dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi).
Tôh. no. 1401. Derge Tanjur, vol. BA, folios 1v.1-78r.7.
Tr. by Sūryagupta and 'Gos Lhas btsas.
Kambala's Sādhananidhi
commentary to the Herukābhidhāna
% the ms. transcribed here
NAK 4-122/vi. bauddhatantra 87
NGM[P/C]P B 31/20
'Herukāvidhāna'
ff. 73, palm-leaf 33.5 x 5.5 cm
% quite a bit of text surviving (and unnoticed by Bandurski but perhaps this is what Shukla talks about) in Göttingen Xc 14/30, but there the text is attributed to one Devagupta (in fact this comm. was translated twice apparently).
% the Tibetan translation:
Sādhananidāna(sic!)śrīcakrasaṃvara-nāma-pañjikā
Dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dka' 'grel sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gleng gzhi.
Tôh. no. 1401. Derge Tanjur, vol. BA, folios 1v.1-78r.7.
Tr. by Sūryagupta and 'Gos Lhas btsas.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
[incipit: 1\verso] namo buddhāya ||
@1A *, ,RGYUD 'GREL BA PA BZHUGS SO, , @1B [DD] #, ,RGYA GAR SKAD DU, S'A DHA NA NI D'A NA SHR'I TZAKRA SAMBA RA N'A MA PANYTZI K'A ,BOD SKAD DU, DPAL 'KHOR LO SDOM PA'I DKA' 'GREL SGRUB PA'I THABS KYI GLENG GZHI ZHES BYA BA, BCOM LDAN 'DAS [DD] DPAL RDO RJE MKHA' 'GRO LA PHYAG 'TSAL LO,
natvā śrīherukaṃ nāthaṃ kāyatrayātmakaṃ sukham |
likhyate śraddhayā kiṃcid guruparvakramāgatam ||
,MGON PO SKU GSUM BDE BA'I BDAG,
,HE RU KA DPAL LA BTUD DE,
,BLA MA BRGYUD RIM LAS 'ONGS PA,
,DAD PAS CUNG ZAD BRI BAR BYA,
\pratika{athe}tyādinaitat tantraṃ tantrāntaraiḥ saṃyuktam |
% ˚aitat tantraṃ \emend, G] ādinaittat tantraṃ \cod
,DE NAS ZHES BYA BA LA SOGS PA NI, ,RGYUD 'DI RGYUD GZHAN GYI MTHA' DANG YANG DAG PAR LDAN PA STE, DE NAS ZHES BYA BA'I SGRA NI SNGON GYI RGYUD LA LTOS PA YIN NO,
tas+ + + + śabdaḥ | pūrvatantrāpekṣayā | asya tantrasyānantaryaṃ dyotayati |
% G: tasmād ayam athaśabdaḥ
,'DIS NI RGYUD 'DI BAR CHAD MED PAR GSAL BAR BYED DO,
yasmāt trayalakṣābhidhāne evaṃ mayety uktam |
% G: trilakṣābhidhāne |
% ˚ābhidhāna \emend] ˚ābhidhāne \cod\acorr, ˚ābhidhānā \cod\pcorr
% evaṃ mayety \emend] eva mayety \cod
,GANG GI PHYIR 'BUM PHRAG GSUM PA ZHES BYA BAR 'DI SKAD BDAG GIS ZHES GSUNGS TE,
ata eva nāsyādau nidānavākyaṃ prayuktam |
% nidāna˚ \cod\acorr] nidānā˚ \cod\pcorr
% G adds: prāg eva prayuktatvāt
DE NYID KYIS NA DANG PO GLENG GZHI'I TSIG RAB TU SBYOR BA MED DE SNGON RAB TU SBYAR BA'I PHYIR,
tantram iti prabandhaḥ |
RGYUD CES BYA BA NI RAB TU 'BREL PA STE,
hetutantram | upāyatantram | phalatantraṃ ca |
% hetutantram \conj] + (tutantra)+ \cod
% G: phalatantram upāyatantraṃ ca
RGYU'I RGYUD DANG THABS KYI RGYUD DANG 'BRAS BU'I RGYUD DO,
hetur gotram | atraiva sādhakā durlabhatarāḥ |
% G: tatra hetur
% hetur \emend] hetu \cod
% for sādhakā Ge might read smth else
,RGYU'I RGYUD NI RIGS TE 'DIR SHIN TU RNYED PAR DKA' BA'I SGRUB PA PO NYID DO,
upāyatantram iti | puraḥsaramaṇḍalapraveśādikrameṇa bhāvanājāpabaliyantramantraprayogādayaḥ |
% mantraprayogādayaḥ \conj] + + + yogādayaḥ \cod
% G: bodhicittapuraḥsara- ... -mantrayantra-
,THABS KYI RGYUD CES BYA BA NI, SNGON DU DKYIL 'KHOR DU ZHUGS PA'I RIM PAS @2A *, ,SGOM PA DANG, BZLAS PA DANG, GTOR MA DANG, 'KHRUL 'KHOR DANG, SNGAGS KYI RAB TU SBYOR BA LA SOGS PA'O,
phalam iti | advayaṃ prakāśaikaniṣṭham | avāggocaram | dūram eva cittavṛtteḥ |
% Ge: advayaṃ prakāśaikaniṣṭham advayam ; G as above
,'BRAS BU'I RGYUD CES BYA BA NI GNYIS SU MED PA GSAL BA GCIG TU GNAS PA STE, NGAG GI SPYOD YUL MA YIN PA DANG, SEMS KYI YUL LAS RING BA NYID DO,
tat kathaṃ prabandhaḥ |
,RAB TU 'BREL BA DE JI LTA BU ZHE NA,
yenātra buddhadharmās tiṣṭhantīty arthaḥ |
GANG 'DIR SANGS RGYAS KYI CHOS RNAMS GNAS PA'O ZHES BYA BA'I DON TE,
asya mudrā akāraḥ |
% mudrā \conj] +(udrā)
% mudrā [G f. change]
'DI'I PHYAG RGYA NI YI GE AA'O,
saṃvṛtyākāreṇa śabdavarṇā asmāt prabhavantīty arthaḥ |
% G sarve varṇā
,AAS SDOM PAS NA YI GE THAMS CAD AA LAS BYUNG BA'O ZHES BYA BA'I DON TO,
\text{śrīvajramaṇḍālaṃkāre} 'py uktam |
% 'py \corr] py \cod
% NB: testimony for the tr. of Rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud (Tōh. 490, f. 42a)
,DPAL RDO RJE SNYING PO RGYAN GYI RGYUD LAS KYANG,
\quote{prajvalantaṃ dīpasadṛśaṃ hṛdi madhyagam anāhatam |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmam ākāraṃ paramaṃ prabhum} iti ||
% G madhyam ... akāram pa[2r]ramaprabhur iti
% also quoted in Raviśrījñāna's Amṛtakaṇikā
% also quoted in Āryadeva's Caryāmelāpakapradīpa
SNYING GA'I DBUS NA MI SHIGS PA, ,RAB TU 'BAR BA MAR ME BZHIN,
,MI 'GYUR MCHOG TU PHRA BA YI, ,AA NI GTZO BO DAM PA'O, ,ZHES GSUNGS PA DANG,
punaś coktaṃ \text{dvikalparāje} ||
YANG BRTAG PA'I RGYAL PO GNYIS PA LAS,
\quote{mahāmudrā sthitā nābhau jvaladdīpaśikhākārā |
ādisvarasvabhāvā sā dhīti budhaiḥ prakalpitā ||}
% approximately Hevajratantra II.iv.40cd-41ab
% also quoted in Raviśrījñāna's Amṛtakaṇikā
% G: prakalpiteti
LTE BAR PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO GNAS, ,'BAR BA MAR ME'I RTZE LTA BU,
,DBYANGS YIG DANG PO'I RANG BZHIN TE, ,BLO ZHES SANGS RGYAS RNAMS KYIS BRTAG ,CES GSUNGS SO,
\pratika{ata} iti | akārāt sarvaṃ \pratika{vakṣya} iti saṃbandhaḥ |
% G: vakṣyate
,DE PHYIR ZHES BYA BA NI, YI GE AA LAS BSHAD PA THAMS CAD 'BYUNG BA'O ZHES BYA BAR SbYAR RO,
kiṃ tat |
,DE GANG ZHE NA,
\pratika{rahasyam} iti | aprakāśyam iti | asyā grotrakāṇāṃ[!?] iti |
% G: aprakāśyam agotrakāṇām iti
GSANG BA ZHES BYA BA LA 'DI'I RIGS RNAMS GSAL BAR MA BYAS PA'O,
aprakāśyaṃ kiṃ tat | sapta gopyam |
% G adds: tadyathā or smth
,GSAL BAR MA BYAS PA DE CI ZHE NA, @2B SBAS PA BDUN TE,
\quote{rahasye tattvadeśe ca | + + + + + + cakre |
% tattvadeśe ca \conj] tatvadeṇa+ (vi) \cod\acorr, titvadeṇa+ (vi) \cod\pcorr; G: tattvadaśake rahasya bīja(?)pañcake
% ca [2\recto] + +
rahasye gūḍhasaṃbhāve | rahasye guhyapadmake |
% G: -sadbhāve
rahasye vijayānande | rahasye sa +v + + + [|]
% G: sarvasaṃgame
+ + + + + nta + + [|]}
% G: sukhāntantarya iti
% UNTRACED; Sampuṭatilaka?
DE NYID GSAL BAR BSHAD PA STE, GSANG BA DE NYID YUL DANG NI, ,GSANG BA RGYAL PO'I 'KHOR LO'O, ,GSANG BA SBAS PA BDEN PA STE, ,GSANG BA GSANG BA'I PADMA STE, ,GSANG BA SA BON GYIS DGA' BA, ,GSANG BA THAMS CAD 'DUS PA STE, ,GSANG BA BAR CHAD MED BDE BA'O, ,ZHES SO,
\pratika{samāsād} iti [|] + + + + (grantha) + + taḥ | bhāvāt | sarvabuddhadharmāṇāṃ saṃgrahakatvāt |
% G: saṃkṣepāt granthapramāṇataḥ na tv arthataḥ |
,MDOR BSDUS PA'O ZHES BYA BA NI YANG DAG PAR BSDU PA STE GZHUNG GI TSAD LA BYA'O, ,DON NI MA YIN TE, SANGS RGYAS KYI CHOS THAMS CAD KYANG SDUD PAR BYED PA'I PHYIR RO,
ata eva samvarābhidhānam iti | saṃvṛṇoti saṃgṛ + + + + + + + + + saṃyogam iti |
% samvarābhidhānam \emend] samvarābhidhānām \cod
% G: saṃvṛṇoti sarvaṃ gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | śrīherukasaṃyogam iti |
,DE NYID NI SDOM PA STE, SDOM PA ZHES BYA BA NI THAMS CAD 'DZIN ZHES BYA BA'I DON NO,
\pratika{śrīheruka} ātmā iti | mudrā vajravārāhī | tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ mahāmudrālakṣaṇam |
% G: śrīherukam ātmānaṃ
,DPAL HE RU KA YANG DAG SBYOR, ,ZHES BYA BA NI, DPAL HE RU KA NI BDAG NYID DO, ,RDO RJE PHAG MO NI PHYAG RGYA STE, DE DAG GI YANG DAG PAR SBYOR BA NI PHYAG RGYA CHEN PO'I MTSAN NYID DO,
kāmyante kāmāḥ | īpsitārthasaṃpadaḥ |
,'DOD PAR BYA BAS NA 'DOD PA STE, 'DOD PA'I DON PHUN SUM TSOGS PA'O,
a + + + + + + + dharatvaṃ sādhayatīti | \pratika{sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ} |
% G: anenaiva sarvabuddhatvaṃ vajradharatvaṃ
,'DIS SANGS RGYAS NYID DANG RDO RJE 'DZIN PA NYID SGRUB PAR BYED PAS NA 'DOD PA'I DON KUN NAS SGRUB PAR BYED PA'O,
kiṃ tat |
,DE GANG ZHE NA,
\pratika{uttarād api cottaram} iti | uttaram utkṛṣṭam |
% utkṛṣṭam \conj] uktārtham \cod, G
BLA MA LAS KYANG BLA MA STE, ,ZHES BYA BA LA BLA MA'I DON GSUNGS TE,
nānādhimuktisattvāśayabhedavaśam + + + + + + sopanāya | caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasradeśanā tasmād api cottarāṃ anuttaraṃ hṛdgatatattvam | sarvabuddhaiḥ savajribhiḥ pratyātmavedyamayeṇa vākpathena + gṛhyate |
% G: ... bhedavaśena satkāyadṛṣṭiśodhanāya ... -deśanāt | ... cottaraṃ | anuttaraṃ hṛdgatatvaṃ | ... -vedyakatveṇa ?????
SEMS CAN MOS PA SNA TSOGS PA'I BSAM PA'I DBYE BA'I DBANG GIS 'JIG TSOGS LA LTA BA DAG PAR BYA BA'I PHYIR CHOS KYI PHUNG PO BRGYAD KHRI BZHI STONG DAG BSTAN TO, ,DE LAS KYANG BLA MAR GYUR PA NYID SNYING LA GNAS PA'I DE KHO NA NYID BLA NA MED PA STE, RDO RJE CAN DANG BCAS PA'I SANGS RGYAS RNAMS KYIS SO SO RANG GIS RIG PA'I RANG BZHIN NYID TSIG GI
LAM LAS 'DAS PA NYID DO,
tasmāt
,DE NYID KYIS NA,
\quote{tattvahīnā na sidhyanti kalpakoṭiśatair api |}
% quoted in Āryadeva's CaMePra as scripture/sūtra
% similar to Padmavajra's Guhyasiddhi 1.26cd.\
BSKAL PA BYE BA BRGYAR YANG NI, ,DE NYID DMAN PAS 'GRUB MI 'GYUR,
ity uktaṃ bhagavatā |
,ZHES BCOM LDAN 'DAS KYIS GSUNGS SO,
\pratika{ḍākinījālasamvaram} iti | parṣatsaṃpattim āha |
,MKHA' 'GRO MA YI DRA BA SDOM, ,ZHES BYA BA NI 'KHOR PHUN SUM TSOGS PA GSUNGS TE,
\quote{ḍai vihāyasagamane} | aikārasyātvāḍānaḍāḥ | ākāśagamanam ity arthaḥ | ḍāśabdāt tṛtīyā | aka + + (na)ṭilāyā gatau | anu sarvato gamanam | kuṭilā yā gati | as + kuṇṭhaśīlam asyā iti ḍākinī | ṛddhyā kāyakoṭiniyutasahasraiḥ | yugapat (sarvathāpi) [2\verso] + tyarthaḥ |
DE NI NAM MKHAR 'GRO MA'O, ,YI GE AE AAR 'GYUR RO, ,'GRO BAS NA d'A STE, NA MA MKHAR 'GRO BA ZHES BYA BA'I DON TO, ,d'A ZHES BYA BA'I SGRA LA GSUNGS PA'O, ,AA KA NI GYA GYUR 'GRO BA STE, 'DIR THAMS CAD DU 'GRO BA NI GYA GYUR 'GRO BA'O, ,DES NA NAM MKHAR 'GRO BA'I NGANG TSUL 'DI LA YOD PAS NA MKHA' 'GRO MA ZHES BYA STE, BYE BA KHRAG KHRIG BRGYA
STONG GI SKU'I RDZU 'PHRUL GYIS THAMS @3A *, ,CAD DU CIG CAR 'GRO BAS ZHES BYA BA'I DON NO,
tāsāṃ jālaṃ samūham ity arthaḥ |
,DE RNAMS KYI DRA BA STE, TSOGS ZHES BYA BA'I THA TSIG GO,
samvaraṃ sukhavaram | tābhiḥ saha kṣaṇakṣaṇasaṃkḷptatvāt |
,SdOM PA NI BDE BA'I MCHOG STE, DE RNAMS KYI LHAN CIG TU SKAD CIG RE RE LA BDE BAS YANG DAG PAR TSIM PA'I PHYIR RO,
\pratika{rahasya} ityādinā ṣoḍaśākṣaramayaṃ śūnyam | sarvaśabdena etā bhaṇyate |
,GSANG BA ZHES BYA BA LA SOGS PA NI STONG PA NYID BCU DRUG GI RANG BZHIN GYI BRDA'I YI GE STE, THAMS CAD KYI SGRA NI DE RNAMS GSUNGS PA YIN NO,
\pratika{ra}kāre raktadhātuś ca |
,RA NI MTSAL CHEN PO YI KHAMS,
\pratika{ha}kāre girijena tu | iti śirojaḥ |
,HA NI RI LAS SKYES PA STE, ,RI SKYES ZHES PA MGO SKYES SO,
\pratika{sye}kāre gandhapātraṃ tu | śarīre yathā gandham [|]
% pātraṃ \emend] patraṃ \cod
,SA NI DRI YI SNOD YIN TE, ,LUS LA DRI NI JI LTA BAR,
\pratika{pa}kāraṃ vegam uddiṣṭam |
% pakāraṃ \emend] paḥkāraṃ \cod
,SA NI RLUNG DU GSUNGS PA STA,
\pratika{ra}kāra gandham evoktam |
,RA NI DRI NYID YIN PAR GSUNGS,
\pratika{me}kāreṇa kusumam |
,YI GE ME NI ME TOG STE,
\pratika{ra}kāraṃ ṇanta + + [|]
,RA NI DE BZHIN LAN TSVA'O,
\pratika{mye}kāreṇa pisitaṃ mata |
,ME NI SHA CHEN POR 'DOD DE,
\pratika{sa}kāraṃ kunduraṃ caiva |
,SA NI RAB TU SBYOR BA NYID,
\pratika{rvā}kāraṃ śiraḥ proktam |
,RBA NI MGO BOR RAB TU GSUNGS,
\pratika{tma}kāraṃ nalajaṃ devi |
% tmakāraṃ \emend] mekāraṃ \cod
,LHA MO ME NI RKANG YIN TE,
\pratika{ni}kāraṃ gandhatailam |
,NI NI DRI YI MAR KHU'O,
\pratika{sa}kāra daṃsakarajam |
,SA NI SO DANG SEN MO STE,
\pratika{dā}kāraṃ sāgarajena tu |
,DA NI RGYA MTSO LAS SKYES SO,
\pratika{sthi}(bhavatu) sārasāram |
,STHI NI KHA BA'I SNYING PO STE,
\pratika{taṃ}kāraṃ karpūraṃ matam ||
% taṃkāraṃ \emend] tagāraṃ \cod
,TA NI GA PUR BSTAN PA'O,
atha vā |
,YANG NA,
ekākārasarvatājñā sarvagā sūkṣmā |
% ekākāra˚] \emend, ekāra˚ \cod
hṛtguhya + + + + + +o rūpā śūnyatā |
,GCIG TU THAMS CAD MKHYEN PA STE,
,KUN DU 'GRO BA SHIN TU PHRA,
,SNYING GI GSANG CHOGS MNYAM PA STE,
,SGYU MA'I RANG BZHIN STONG PA NYID,
cittasya rūpā | acintā cintāmaṇir ivāparā
nātmāprajñeti sā smṛtā rahasyeti ca vikhyātā |
,SEMS KYI RANG BZHIN BSAM ME KHYAB,
,YID BZHIN NOR BU 'DRA BA BZHIN,
,SHES RAB MING DU DE BRJOD DO,
,GSANG BA ZHES KYANG BSHAD PA YIN,
paramāparamārthena dharmakāya + + + + + + + + + yena|
sarvajñajñānasya ramyā iti ca kathyate||
,MCHOG NI DON DAM NYID KYIS TE,
,CHOS KYI SKU ZHES DE BRJOD DO,
,LHAG MTHONG KUN MKHYEN YE SHES KYI,
,DGYES PA ZHES NI BSHAD PA YIN,
acintasthiracalasarvatā ca svabhāvena sahajānandapradīpā sā|
sarvātmanīti sarvendriya ca vijñānaṃ sacittaṃ sarva + + + + + + + + ram iti khyātā prajñābuddhimatiḥ smṛtā||
,BSAM GYIS MI KHYAB BRTAN PA DANG,
,G-YO BA'I DNGOS PO THAMS CAD KYI;
,RANG BZHIN LHAN CIG SKYES PA YI,
,DGA' BA RAB TU 'BAR BDE'O,
,THAMS CAD BDAG NYID CES BYA NI,
,DBANG PO KUN DANG RNAM SHES SEMS,
,THAMS CAD NAS NI THAMS CAD DU,
,YID KYI RNAM SHES ZHES BSHAD CING,
,SHES RAB BLO GROS BLOR YANG BRJOD,
sadeti| atītānāgatavartamānātmakaṃ paraṃ| anenotpādavināśarahitaṃ| vyāpitvaṃ vajrakāyatvaṃ| ta + + + + + + + + + + tvaṃ| + + + kārālikatvaṃ ca + + + + + +
,RTAG TU ZHES BYA BA NI,
,'DAS PA DANG NI MA 'ONGS DANG,
,DA LTA'I BDAG NYID CAN GYI MCHOG,
,'DI YIS SKYE DANG 'JIG SPANGS 'DI,
,KHYAB NYID RDO RJE'I SKU NYID DE,
,DBANG DU BYED CING RTAG SHAR NYID,
,DUS KUN CAN NYID BSHAD PA YIN,
sthita iti [3\recto missing]
,BZHUGS ZHES BYA BA LA, KUN NAS SEMS CAN THAMS CAD KYI, , @3B KHAMS KUN LA NI THAMS CAD DU, ,LUS KUN LA NI MNYAM KHYAB PAR, ,SEMS KYI RGYUN NYID YANG DAG GNAS, ,ZAG PA MED CING BSAM MI KHYAB, ,DRI MA MED CING BDAG GIS MED, ,RANG NYID STONG PA MKHA' MNYAM PAS, ,DNGOS DANG DNGOS MED RNAM PAR SPANGS, ,THOG MA THA MA MED ZHI BA, , CHOS RNAMS KUN GYI
DBANG PHYUG SKU, ,KUN GYI RANG BZHIN 'DZIN PAS NA, ,BDEN PA GNYIS LA YANG DAG BRTEN, ,JI LTAR SHING LA RAB BRTEN PA, ,ME YI SA BON RNAM GNAS DANG, ,JI LTAR TIL GYI 'BRU RNAMS LA, ,TIL GYI MAR KHU DE LTAR NI, ,KHAMS GSUM LA NI RNAM GNAS PA, ,PHYAG RGYA CHEN POR SHES PAR BYA, ,ZHES BYA BAR DGONGS SO, ,MKHA' 'GRO KUN DNGOS SEMS DPA' NI, ,ZHES BYA BA
LA, MKHA' 'GRO MA KUN GYI SGRAS NI RAB TU GTUM MO LA SOGS PAR 'DOD LA, DE RNAMS KYI PHRA RAB YONGS SU BSGRUBS PAS NA, DE RNAMS KYI DNGOS KYI RANG BZHIN NO, ,DE SU ZHIG CE NA, SEMS DPA' ZHES BYA STE, RGYU BA DANG MI RGYU BA'I BYE BRAG GI GNYIS SO, ,SEMS CAN RGYU BA ZHES BSHAD LA, ,SNOD KYI 'JIG RTEN MI RGYU BA'O, ,ZHES GSUNGS SO,
,RDO RJE SEMS DPA' BDE BA MCHOG ,CES BYA BA LA, MI PHYED PAS NA RDO RJE STE, RDO RJE DANG CHOS MTHUN PAS GZHAN RNAMS 'BIGS PA'I PHYIR RO;
,DE BAS NA SEMS DPA' STE, DNGOS BO THAMS CAD GCIG TU GYUR PA NYID DO, ,RDO RJE YANG YIN LA SEMS DPA' YANG YIN PAS RDO RJE SEMS DPA' STE, DNGOS BDE DNGOS PO MED PA BDE, ,RDO RJE SEMS DPA' BDE BAR BRJOD, ,'DI NI ZHES BYA BA NI DES PAR GZUNG BA STE, DE NYID BCOM LDAN RANG 'BYUNG ZHES BYA BA LA, BRTAN PA DANG G-YO BA DANG GROL BA MA LUS PA RNAMS RANG
